oxygen_consumption.description: Average daily oxygen consumption rate for an astronaut under nominal light-to-moderate metabolic workload (~2800 kcal/day).
oxygen_consumption.citation: Ewert, M. K., & Stromgren, C. (2019). Astronaut Mass Balance. NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS 20190027563).
oxygen_consumption.reality_vs_game: Real astronauts consume between 0.78 and 0.90 kg O2/day depending on body mass and exercise intensity. The game uses a standardized 0.84 kg/day (35 g/hr) per crew member.

carbon_dioxide_production.description: Average carbon dioxide output exhaled by an astronaut per day.
carbon_dioxide_production.citation: NASA Spaceflight Human-System Standard NASA-STD-3001, Volume 1: Crew Health.
carbon_dioxide_production.reality_vs_game: Real CO2 output varies with diet and exertion; 1.0 kg/day corresponds to a respiratory exchange ratio of approximately 0.86.

water_consumption.description: Total clean potable water required per astronaut per day for metabolic hydration, food preparation, and basic hygiene.
water_consumption.citation: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 Rev C, Table: Consumables Specifications.
water_consumption.reality_vs_game: Real deep-space baseline is 2.5 L drinking + 1.5 L hygiene/prep. The game tracks total drinking and hygiene as a single reserve bar.

food_calorie_requirement.description: Average nutritional energy requirement for crew members operating in partial gravity or microgravity.
food_calorie_requirement.citation: NASA Human Integration Design Handbook (HIDH), Section 7.2: Nutrition and Metabolic Intake.
food_calorie_requirement.reality_vs_game: Real crew require 2400 to 3200 kcal/day based on mass, sex, and EVA exercise schedule. Fixed at 2800 kcal/day in game.

water_recovery_system.description: Percentage of greywater, urine condensate, and atmospheric moisture recovered as potable drinking water by the ECLSS loop.
water_recovery_system.citation: NASA (2023). NASA Achieves 98% Water Recovery Milestone on International Space Station.
water_recovery_system.reality_vs_game: On ISS, achieving 98% required the Urine Processor Assembly (UPA) plus the BPA (Brine Processor Assembly). The game integrates this into the Water Recycler module.

eva_spacesuit_specs.citation: NASA STEM Activity: Artemis Generation Spacesuits & JSC EVA Overview (NTRS 20120011735).
eva_spacesuit_specs.reality_vs_game: Apollo suits ran at 3.75 psia, EMU at 4.3 psia. xEMU operates at 4.3 psia pure O2. The game imposes a strict 7-hour sortie limit before emergency return.

lunar_environment_specs.citation: NASA Science: Moon Facts, Weather on the Moon & Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) Diviner Data.
lunar_environment_specs.reality_vs_game: Lunar equatorial temperatures swing between +127°C and -173°C. In the polar landing areas (Artemis III), high ridges enjoy longer light, but shadows drop to -246°C. Game uses +127°C / -173°C as standard baseline.
